_comment: Hand-maintained catalog of Camunda 8 artifacts beyond the local development downloads. Not touched by hacks/update-downloads.js. Placeholders: {camundaVersion} = latest Orchestration Cluster release, {connectorsVersion} = latest connectors release (both from downloads.json).

sections.title: CLI and SDKs
sections.description: Work with Camunda from your terminal and your code.

items.name: Camunda CLI (c8ctl)
items.description: Deploy resources, start process instances, and inspect clusters from your terminal. Installs the c8ctl and c8 commands. Requires Node.js 22.18 or later.

items.name: Java client
items.description: Java client for the Orchestration Cluster REST API.

items.name: Camunda Spring Boot Starter
items.description: Build job workers and process applications with Spring Boot 4. Use camunda-spring-boot-3-starter for Spring Boot 3.

items.name: Camunda Process Test
items.description: Test your processes with JUnit. Use camunda-process-test-java without Spring.

items.name: Connector SDK
items.description: Build custom outbound and inbound connectors.

items.name: TypeScript client
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for Node.js and the browser.

items.name: Camunda 8 SDK for Node.js
items.description: Node.js SDK with job workers and all Camunda 8 APIs.

items.name: Python SDK
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for Python.

items.name: C# SDK
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for .NET.

items.name: Go SDK
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for Go.

items.name: Rust SDK
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for Rust.

items.name: PHP SDK
items.description: Orchestration Cluster API client for PHP.

sections.title: Self-Managed deployment
sections.description: Run Camunda in your own infrastructure. All images and charts are public.

items.name: Helm chart
items.description: Deploy Camunda 8 to any Kubernetes cluster. Chart camunda/camunda-platform.
items.install:
helm repo add camunda https://helm.camunda.io
helm install camunda camunda/camunda-platform

items.name: Docker images
items.description: Also available: camunda/connectors-bundle, camunda/optimize, camunda/identity, camunda/hub, camunda/hub-websockets, camunda/keycloak.

items.name: Docker Compose
items.description: Run the full Camunda 8 stack locally for development and evaluation.

items.name: Reference architectures
items.description: Terraform modules and scripts for EKS, AKS, OpenShift, ECS, and EC2.

sections.title: Migrate from Camunda 7
sections.description: Tools to move models, code, and data from Camunda 7 to Camunda 8.

items.name: Migration tooling
items.description: Diagram Converter, Data Migrator, and Cockpit plugin.

items.name: Code conversion recipes
items.description: OpenRewrite recipes that convert Camunda 7 Java code.

sections.title: Enterprise
sections.description: Enterprise customers and partners log in with their Camunda Enterprise credentials. To get credentials, contact your Customer Success Manager or Partner Manager.

items.name: ProcessOS
items.description: ProcessOS Harness packages for your AI coding agent.

items.name: Camunda Enterprise Registry
items.description: Mirror of all public images, plus enterprise-only images such as Keycloak EE.

items.name: Camunda Artifactory
items.description: Enterprise Maven repositories, including Camunda 7 Enterprise.

sections.title: Release information
sections.description: Check what changed and what is supported before you upgrade.
